Azalea chat source vendored from upstream revision
41a9ae6aaff77646c08c64ac1334a8cc6081c24f (Minecraft 1.21.11 branch).
Upstream repository: https://github.com/azalea-rs/azalea
The original MIT license is retained in LICENSE.

Eltharn changes: standalone Cargo dependency declarations, support for legacy
plugin `clickEvent` style fields next to the canonical 1.21.11 `click_event`
fields, a privacy-safe RawComponentInteractionProbe (structural style-field
counts only; no text, URLs, commands or custom NBT retained). Upstream test
sources are omitted from the product source tree. No account data or generated
game captures included.

This component remains under the upstream MIT license; the Eltharn
non-commercial license does not apply to it. See the workspace LICENSE and
third-party notice records.
